offering_description.value: Provides international money transfers for consumers sending funds to family and others abroad, primarily to Latin America and the Caribbean. It accepts transfers through retail agents, company-operated stores, and digital channels, and delivers funds through local payout partners and bank deposits.

primary_services.value: international money transfers; check cashing; money order issuance

customer_segment.value: B2C: People sending money abroad, particularly immigrants supporting family members

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Fees on individual transfers, check cashing, and money orders; other: Foreign exchange spreads on cross-currency transfers

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Accepts funds and payment instructions from consumers and settles transfers to recipients abroad; service provider: Cashes checks and issues money orders for retail customers

geography_served.value: global: Transfers from the United States, Canada, and parts of Europe, with major payout markets in Latin America and the Caribbean

specialization.value: related lines: International remittances, check cashing, and money orders

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: Independent retail money transfer agents; own locations: Company-operated money transfer stores; online: Consumer website and mobile app; partners / resellers: Banks and local retail partners that deliver funds to recipients
distribution_channels.category: agents / brokers; own locations; online; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State money transmitter licensing, FinCEN registration, anti-money-laundering rules, and consumer remittance protections

notes: The current status of Western Union’s announced acquisition is uncertain.
